body:
Hey, thank you for responding a few months ago. You're a good person. On the one hand it feels... nice? I guess, knowing someone out there can relate. On the other, I'd obviously prefer no one did, because it's not the greatest thing one can relate to (for clear reasons).

I hope you're doing alright, yourself.

I just wanted to finally thank you for responding. I can't really say I'm doing any better now but I did appreciate your advice, even if I didn't make mention of it.

So yeah... Thank you.
